text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release v2.5.3 -> prod (us-west-2). Canary groups: 3 total, 1/3 healthy. changelog: https://confluence.redwood/prod-releases/2.5.3 :rocket:

jordana: seeing p95 spike in canary-2, +180ms baseline. digging.

kevin: frontend reports spike and ~3x increase in 502s from inference pool.

maria: pager fired for 5xx ratio > 1% in us-west-2-canary. oncall on it.

ops-bot: Incident alert: canary 5xx rate breached threshold (1.0%). ID=inc-1819876500.

sre-oncall: starting rollback safety checklist. @jordana @kevin can you confirm root cause signals? Any config mismatch or OOMs?

alex: quick look at logs: repeated `kv-cache` OOMs in the quantized path for v2.5.3; also some reranker timeouts.

pm-lina: user-impacting — prefer rollback now. Who can execute manual revert and pin?

jordana: I'll lead rollback. Plan: 1) pin traffic to v2.5.2, 2) scale down 2.5.3, 3) validate smoke tests, 4) notify customers. Agree?

kevin: +1. Add: disable autoscaling on the pool during rollback to avoid churn.

jordana: Commands I'll run:```bash
# pin image to previous stable
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:2.5.2
# wait for rollout
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference -w
# pin via control plane to prevent automatic upgrades
redwoodctl pin-version --env=prod --model=inference --version=2.5.2
# scale down the problematic replica set
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference --replicas=0 --selector=version=2.5.3
```

maria: I'll run canary smoke script after you pin: `/scripts/smoke_canary.sh --region=us-west-2`

sre-oncall: I'll post to #incidents and notify CS: `@cs-team` — prepare holding message. Setting change window: immediate, expected ECD 10m.

alex: I'll also flip a temporary flag to force fallback model while we stabilize: `FEATURE_FALLBACK_MODEL=true` (pushed to staging config, will roll to prod after pin).

ops-bot: Deploy bot: initiating rollback job rb-1819876500. Estimated duration 5m.

jordana: rollback started. pin command succeeded, rollout completed for image 2.5.2.

kevin: metrics update: p95 trending down, p50 stable, 5xx now 0.18% and falling. :thumbsup:

pm-lina: great. Maria, please draft short customer note: what happened, that we reverted to previous release, and we're investigating root cause. cc legal/security.

maria: drafting now, will share bulletin in #product-customer-comm once ready.

sre-oncall: we'll keep the pin for 2 hours and run a targeted canary with quantization flags off after that. If green, schedule a controlled re-release with runtime fix.

alex: opened ticket INF-3456 with logs and stack traces for eng-runtime (kv-cache OOMs + reranker timeouts).

jordana: ticket INF-3456 created and linked to incident. assigning to @eng-runtime.

ops-bot: Rollback job rb-1819876500 complete. All readiness checks passed. Post-rollback health: p95 within SLO, error rate under threshold.

sre-oncall: closing incident on our side but keeping monitor up for 1h. Postmortem template assigned to oncall.

kevin: thanks everyone. follow-up: repro instructions and small test harness in INF-3456 would help.

pm-lina: please add a short blurb in release notes about the revert and follow-up timeline.

maria: will update release notes and customer comms.

deploy-bot: Note: rollback job rb-1819876500 logged at 1819876590, duration 3m.``
